# Example adapted from presentation slides

Slide 55=ish onwards:

```{r cars}
expit <- function(v){
  exp(v)/(1+exp(v))
}
set.seed(123)
N <- 1000
X <- rnorm(N); U <- rnorm(N)
Z <- 0.2*U+X+rnorm(N)*0.25; W <- 0.2*U+X+rnorm(N)*0.25
A <- rbinom(N,1,expit(0.2+0.25*Z+0.1*X+0.25*U))
Y0 <- 2*U+W+X+rnorm(N)*0.25
Y1 <- 1+2*U+W+X+rnorm(N)*0.25
Y <- A*Y1+(1-A)*Y0
mean(Y1-Y0)
Data <- data.frame(Y=Y,A=A,W=W,Z=Z,X=X)
col.Y = 1
col.A = 2
col.W = 3
col.Z = 4
col.X = 5
```


```{r}
LM.X <- lm(Y~A+X, data=Data)
summary(LM.X)
```
```{r}
LM.XWZ <- lm(Y~A+X+W+Z,data=Data)
summary(LM.XWZ)
```
 The OLS estimates are severely biased. (1.7 and 1.2)

```{r}
Prox.TSLS.W <- lm(W~A+Z+X, data=Data)
Data.Add <- cbind(Data,What=Prox.TSLS.W$fitted.values)
Prox.TSLS.Y <- lm(Y~A+What+X,data=Data.Add)
summary(Prox.TSLS.Y)
```
 unbiased

 correct SE, with IVreg, because IVreg is accounting for variablitiy in the first stage:

```{r}
library(ivreg)
## ivreg(Y~A+W+X|A+Z+X,data)
IVReg <- ivreg::ivreg(Y~A+W+X|A+Z+X,data=Data)
summary(IVReg)
```


## Bridge Function

```{r}
h1 <- function(data,theta.h){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## h(a=1,w,x) = b1 + b1w*w + b1x*x
  return( as.vector(
    as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.W, col.X)]))%*%theta.h # [1,A=1,W,X]*theta
    ))
}
```

```{r}
moment.h1 <- function(data,theta.h){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## E[ g_h(A=1,Z,X) * {Y-h(A=1,W,X)} ] = 0
  Residuals <- as.matrix(
    data[,col.A]*cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z,col.X)])*
      as.vector((data[,col.Y]-h1(data,theta.h))))

return( sum(apply(Residuals,2,mean)^2) )
}
```

```{r}
h0 <- function(data,theta.h){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## h(a=0,w,x) = b0 + b0w*w + b0x*x return( as.vector(
as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.W, col.X)]))%*%theta.h # [1,A=1,W,X]*theta ))
}
```

```{r}
moment.h0 <- function(data,theta.h){
  ## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
  ## E[ g_h(A=0,Z,X) * {Y-h(A=0,W,X)} ] = 0
  Residuals <- as.matrix(
      (1-data[,col.A])*cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z,col.X)])* # g_h(A=0,Z,X
        as.vector((data[,col.Y]-h0(data,theta.h))) # Y-h(A=0,W,X)
)
    return( sum(apply(Residuals,2,mean)^2) )
  }
```

```{r}
q1 <- function(data,theta.q){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## q(a=1,z,x) = expit(c1 + c1z*z + c2z*x)
  return( exp(as.vector(
as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z, col.X)]))%*%theta.q # [1,Z,X]*theta
)))
}
```

```{r}
moment.q1 <- function(data,theta.q){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## E[ {1-q(A=1,Z,X)}*g_q(A=1,W,X) ] = 0
  Residuals <- as.matrix(
as.vector(1 - q1(data,theta.q)*data[,col.A])* cbind(1,data[,c(col.W,col.X)]) )
return( sum(apply(Residuals,2,mean)^2) ) }
```


```{r}
q0 <- function(data,theta.q){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## q(a=0,z,x) = expit(c0 + c0z*z + c0z*x)
  return( exp(as.vector(
as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z, col.X)]))%*%theta.q # [1,Z,X]*theta
)))

}
```

```{r}
moment.q0 <- function(data,theta.q){
## data = [Y,A,W,Z,X]
## E[ {1-q(A=0,Z,X)}*g_q(A=0,W,X) ] = 0
  Residuals <- as.matrix(
as.vector(1 - q0(data,theta.q)*(1-data[,col.A]))* cbind(1,data[,c(col.W,col.X)]) )
return( sum(apply(Residuals,2,mean)^2) )
}
```

```{r}
Proximal <- function(data){
h1.para <- optim(par=c(sum(IVReg$coefficients[c(1,2)]), IVReg$coefficients[c(3,4)]), fn=function(theta){moment.h1(data,theta)})

h0.para <- optim(par=c(IVReg$coefficients[c(1,3,4)]), fn=function(theta){moment.h0(data,theta)})

GLM.init <- glm(A~1+Z+X,data=data,family="binomial")$coefficients

q1.para <- optim(par=GLM.init, fn=function(theta){moment.q1(data,theta)})

q0.para <- optim(par=GLM.init, fn=function(theta){moment.q0(data,theta)})

h1.hat <- as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.W,col.X)]))%*%h1.para$par

h0.hat <- as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.W,col.X)]))%*%h0.para$par

q1.hat <- exp(as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z,col.X)]))%*%as.vector(q1.para$par))

q0.hat <- exp(as.matrix(cbind(1,data[,c(col.Z,col.X)]))%*%as.vector(q0.para$par))

ATE.IPW <- mean((data$A*q1.hat-(1-data$A)*q0.hat)*data$Y)
ATE.OR <- mean(h1.hat-h0.hat)
ATE.AIPW <- mean(data$A*q1.hat*(data$Y-h1.hat)- (1-data$A)*q0.hat*(data$Y-h0.hat) + (h1.hat-h0.hat) )

return(c(ATE.IPW,ATE.OR,ATE.AIPW))
}
```

```{r}
Proximal(Data)
Bootstrap <- matrix(0,100,3)
for(bb in 1:100){
  Bootstrap[bb,] <- Proximal(Data[sample(N,N,replace=TRUE),])
}
apply(Bootstrap,2,function(vv){quantile(vv,c(0.025,0.975))})
```

## Causal Chambers analysis

```{r}
normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

```{r}
load_cc_data <- function(path) { # create a function with the name my_function
  cc_Data <- read_csv(path)
  cc_Data = as.data.frame(cc_Data)
  col.U = match("green",names(cc_Data))
  col.Y = match("ir_3",names(cc_Data))
  col.A = match("led_3_uv",names(cc_Data))
  col.W = match("pol_1",names(cc_Data))
  col.Z = match("led_2_uv",names(cc_Data))
  col.X = match("red",names(cc_Data))
  col.Y1 = match("Y1",names(cc_Data))
  col.Y0 = match("Y0",names(cc_Data))

  #cc_Data[,col.Y] <- normalize(cc_Data[,col.Y])
  cc_Data[,col.A] <- normalize(cc_Data[,col.A])

  cc_Data_df <- data.frame(U=cc_Data[,col.U],Y=cc_Data[,col.Y],A=cc_Data[,col.A],W=cc_Data[,col.W],Z=cc_Data[,col.Z],X=cc_Data[,col.X],Y1=cc_Data[,col.Y1], Y0=cc_Data[,col.Y0])
  colnames(cc_Data_df) <- c("U", "Y", "A", "W", "Z", "X", "Y1", "Y0")
  col.U = match("U",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.Y = match("Y",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.A = match("A",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.W = match("W",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.Z = match("Z",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.X = match("X",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.Y1 = match("Y1",names(cc_Data_df))
  col.Y0 = match("Y0",names(cc_Data_df))
  return(list(df=cc_Data_df, colU = col.U, colY = col.Y,colA = col.A,colW = col.W,colZ = col.Z,colX = col.X,colY1 = col.Y1,colY0 = col.Y0))
}
```

```{r}
strong_confounding = "out_binaryA_counterfactuals_BLUE.csv" # strong confounding
weak_confounding = "out_binaryA_counterfactuals_BLUE_pol2+90.csv" #weak confounding
data_strong_conf = load_cc_data(strong_confounding)
data_weak_conf = load_cc_data(weak_confounding)
```

ATEs
```{r}
summary(data_strong_conf$df[,data_strong_conf$colY1]-data_strong_conf$df[,data_strong_conf$colY0])
```
```{r}
summary(data_weak_conf$df[,data_weak_conf$colY1]-data_weak_conf$df[,data_weak_conf$colY0])
```
